evidence: dead_air: seg1 and seg3 are the same beat: the same two-circle template, the same mascot perched on the big circle and the same 'TOPS THE LIST' kicker, with only the numbers changed. The hook ruler also holds unchanged from 0.3s to 6.4s (hook@0.3 to seg1:start).

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:start/mid/end show two horizontal rows, 'Before 2014 100%' and 'Since 2014 10.1K%'. A mascot stands in each row, the number text slides sideways, and a dotted vertical rail sits at the right edge. No urchins appear and nothing grows.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The strongest number in the story, a more than 10,000% urchin explosion, was rendered as a two-row label comparison. Nothing in the picture carries the multiplication, and the '10.1K%' abbreviation turns a jaw-dropping figure into a cryptic label.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Draw the explosion as urchins. One purple urchin before 2014 multiplies into roughly 100 urchins that swarm and fill the seafloor. Data is swamped or climbs out of the pile. Spell out the figure as '+10,000%' or '100x'.
